definitions.explanation: The official clothing worn by members of armed forces, including the various types of dress and combat uniforms.

examples.japanese: {軍服|ぐんぷく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧たち。
⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軍服|ぐんぷく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Old military uniforms were on display at the museum.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧ (military) and ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (clothing). Used in historical, military, and fashion contexts. Note the rendaku: ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ becomes {服|ぷく} after ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軍服|ぐんぷく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a military uniform
- {軍服|ぐんぷく}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: figure in military uniform
- {旧日本軍|きゅうにほんぐん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軍服|ぐんぷく}: uniforms of the former Japanese military

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧: uniform — the general term for any uniform (school, company, etc.)
- {迷彩服|めいさいふく}: camouflage uniform — specifically patterned for concealment
- {戦闘服|せんとうふく}: combat uniform, battle dress — for field operations
